analysis_type: Read-only bounded synthesis of the latest Chwirut1 log-support, Roszman1 joint-linear arctangent and ENSO phase-interval triple-intersection results; model-specific baselines and units only, no cross-dataset pooled width, unified score or global optimum claim

recomputation_rule.receipt_gate: Require every receipt to have status passed and its summarySha256 to match the corresponding frozen bounds file
recomputation_rule.chwirut1: Use held_out_point_count=214, unique_distance_count=22, alternative_tighter_count=22, intersection_tightened_count=22, candidate_evaluation_count=132, nonempty_intersection_count=22 and all zero violation fields
recomputation_rule.roszman1: Use held_out_point_count=25, available_point_count=20, unavailable_point_count=5, unavailable_fold_ids=[5], alternative_tighter_count=20, intersection_tightened_count=20, candidate_evaluation_count=160, nonempty_intersection_count=20 and all zero violation fields
recomputation_rule.enso: Use held_out_point_count=168, phase_alternative_bound_count=168, triple_intersection_bound_count=168, triple_tightened_count=37, triple_unchanged_count=131, candidate_evaluation_count=672, nonempty_triple_intersection_count=168 and all zero violation fields
recomputation_rule.aggregate_counts: Sum only inventory quantities: 407 held-out observations, 402 available observations, 5 unavailable observations, 210 unique envelopes, 79 tightened envelopes, 131 unchanged envelopes, 210 nonempty intersections and 964 candidate evaluations
recomputation_rule.unavailable_preservation: Roszman1 fold 5 retains five unavailable points and is not counted as an available or tightened envelope
recomputation_rule.source_consistency: Recompute all aggregate fields from the frozen records and reject any mismatch rather than editing source results

comparison_rule.model_specific_baselines: Chwirut1 uses its stage-44 independent envelope, Roszman1 uses its stage-46 independent envelope, and ENSO uses its stage-51 Lipschitz intersection. These baselines are not interchangeable
comparison_rule.ratio_scope: Width ratios remain within each model and baseline. Do not rank models or methods by raw widths, RMSE, covariance, parameters or residual bounds
comparison_rule.inventory_scope: Counts of envelopes, tightened cases, unchanged cases and candidates are inventory descriptions, not probabilities, calibrated coverage or a unified stability score
comparison_rule.method_scope: Log secants/tangents, joint linear support and exact trigonometric interval arithmetic are model-specific constructions and are not a single global optimizer
comparison_rule.candidate_scope: All 964 candidate evaluations are implementation-consistency checks, not a global optimality proof or independent physical experiment
comparison_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite the three source summaries, receipts, earlier reports or historical baselines

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生三模型保守支撑综合_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting or modification of source results, baselines, receipts or historical reports
No pooling or ranking of raw widths, RMSE, parameters, covariances or residual bounds across datasets
No unified stability score, probability coverage, universal model winner or global optimum claim
No treating candidate checks as the analytic proof or a global optimizer
No dropping of Roszman1 fold-5 unavailable points or assigning them finite bounds
No hiding of unchanged intersections, source-specific limitations or unavailable cases
